title: Entry: dashboard, invite, admission, prejoin, embed and boot

fields.name: arrival_handle
fields.doc: A public arrival's handle (the public invite credential header value's row id). It is a handle, not a credential; never log the invite token.

fields.name: entry_path
fields.doc: Which entry path a page boot belongs to, classified at the beacon; site is a page that is not an entry path.

fields.name: framed
fields.doc: Whether the page ran inside a frame (window.top !== window.self) at boot.

fields.name: policy_camera
fields.doc: Whether the embedding document's permissions policy allows camera, or unavailable(no_api) when no policy API exists.

fields.name: policy_microphone
fields.doc: Whether the embedding document's permissions policy allows microphone, or unavailable(no_api) when no policy API exists.

fields.name: visibility
fields.doc: The document's visibility state when the fact was recorded.

fields.name: storage_state
fields.doc: Whether durable local storage was usable at boot.

fields.name: reloaded
fields.doc: Whether the one allowed reload-after-chunk-failure was taken.

fields.name: app_shown
fields.doc: True once surface(boot.app) was shown on this client session.

fields.name: route_id
fields.doc: The TanStack route ID (such as /_space/$code), never the path, which can carry an invite code.

fields.name: error_name
fields.doc: An Error or DOMException name, such as NotAllowedError.

fields.name: error_class
fields.doc: The closed render-error classes slice 9's render_crashed fields define.

fields.name: error_fingerprint
fields.doc: A stable hash of the render error's distinguishing fields.

fields.name: state_epoch
fields.doc: The public invite row's state epoch at the decision, so a reader can line the row up with it.

fields.name: invite_generation
fields.doc: A public invite's generation, on the invite row or copied onto an arrival.

fields.name: participant_id_hash
fields.doc: The canonical Participant ID hashed exactly as Sync hashes it on websocket authentication.

fields.name: blocked_origin
fields.doc: The origin (scheme, host and port) a policy blocked; never a full URL.

fields.name: directive
fields.doc: The CSP directive name a violation report names, such as connect-src.

fields.name: device
fields.doc: Which media device an error concerns.

fields.name: phase
fields.doc: The entrance phase a pagehide fact was recorded in.

fields.name: page
fields.doc: The dashboard API page name a request targeted.

fields.name: method
fields.doc: The HTTP method of a request.

fields.name: http_route
fields.doc: The API route a request matched, with placeholders; never a raw URL.

fields.name: http_status
fields.doc: An HTTP response status code.

fields.name: upstream_status
fields.doc: The status a dashboard server function got from its upstream API call.

fields.name: upstream_journey_id
fields.doc: The journey the upstream API stamped on its response.

fields.name: auth_result
fields.doc: Why a dashboard session cookie failed authentication.

fields.name: path_class
fields.doc: The edge rollup's route class; space_page covers the Space document patterns.

fields.name: content_class
fields.doc: The edge rollup's response content class.

fields.name: ua_class
fields.doc: The edge rollup's user-agent class.

fields.name: edge_status
fields.doc: The response status an edge rollup bucket counts.

fields.name: request_count
fields.doc: How many requests an edge rollup bucket counted in its window.

fields.name: window_start_ms
fields.doc: The inclusive start of a rollup window.

fields.name: window_end_ms
fields.doc: The exclusive end of a rollup window.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: A public invite row's enabled flag.

fields.name: disabled_at
fields.doc: When a public invite row was disabled, in server milliseconds; null means never disabled.

fields.name: rotated_at
fields.doc: When a public invite row was last rotated, in server milliseconds.

fields.name: archived_at
fields.doc: When a Space row was archived, in server milliseconds; null means not archived.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When a row was last updated, in server milliseconds.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When a row was created, in server milliseconds.

fields.name: joined_at
fields.doc: When a Participant joined its Episode, in server milliseconds.

fields.name: requested_at
fields.doc: When an admission request was created, in server milliseconds.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: When an admission request expires, in server milliseconds.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.doc: When a terminal admission outcome was committed, in server milliseconds.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.doc: When an admission request's decision committed, in server milliseconds; the proof a host's answer landed.

fields.name: ended_at
fields.doc: When an Episode ended, in server milliseconds.

fields.name: admission_status
fields.doc: An admission request's status in its row: space_public_admission_requests uses approved, sync_admission_requests uses admitted.

fields.name: participant_status
fields.doc: A Participant row's status, such as active.

fields.name: manage_admission
fields.doc: Whether a Participant's capabilities include manageAdmission.

fields.name: arrival_state
fields.doc: A public arrival's state, such as pending or admitted.

fields.name: terminal_reason
fields.doc: Why a public arrival went terminal, such as admission_not_collected.

fields.name: admission_mode
fields.doc: A Space's admission mode.

fields.name: episode_status
fields.doc: An Episode row's status.

fields.name: credential_kind
fields.doc: Whether the presented invite credential was a code or a signed token; never its value.

fields.name: operation
fields.doc: The public-invite operation a request ran, such as public.arrive or public.status.

fields.name: decided_by
fields.doc: The User who committed an admission decision.

fields.name: record_name
fields.doc: The registry event a copied client record carried, on the API's entry-intake copy.

events.name: boot.started
events.doc: The inline boot beacon ran: the first client fact of every page, minted before authentication with its cs_ and dev_.

events.name: boot.visible
events.doc: The beacon saw the first transition to visible; the boot.app_failed clock starts here when the page was hidden at boot.

events.name: boot.pagehide
events.doc: The beacon's last word on pagehide, with app_shown false when the app never showed its first screen.

events.name: boot.chunk_failed
events.doc: A code chunk failed to load and the one allowed reload either ran (reloaded=true) or had already been spent.

events.name: boot.render_failed
events.doc: The root route caught a render error before the call UI mounted and reported it through sendEntryEvent.

events.name: boot.error_page
events.doc: The root route's error page was shown; paired with boot.render_failed but never dropped when the fact is missing.

events.name: boot.app
events.doc: The app's first screen was shown; through ObservedSurface in RootComponent.

events.name: boot.load_call_ui
events.doc: Loading the admitted call UI (the SpaceCall chunk); ok at callUiReady, error(boot.chunk_load) or error(boot.load_failed) at callUiFailed.

events.name: invite.arrive
events.doc: The client's arrival request; terminal ok, or error carrying the generic refusal the client is allowed to see.

events.name: invite.failure
events.doc: The invite failure screen was shown; proves display, never the server-side cause.

events.name: admission.status_poll
events.doc: One client status poll attempt while waiting for the host's answer; a measurement, not an op.

events.name: admission.pagehide
events.doc: The entrance page hid, with the phase it was in; phase=waiting before approval is the guest_left witness.

events.name: prejoin.access_edge
events.doc: One prejoin.access transition, carried as a fact row so a fact can read it; the transition itself is the machine.

events.name: prejoin.device_error
events.doc: getUserMedia failed in prejoin; carries the DOMException name classify drops.

events.name: prejoin.access_card
events.doc: The prejoin access card was shown to the visitor.

events.name: embed.get_access
events.doc: The embed's call for a host access grant; a resolved promise is not proof of connection.

events.name: embed.join_error
events.doc: The embed's join error was shown; its message copies the transport's error and is not a second witness.

events.name: embed.csp_violation
events.doc: A securitypolicyviolation inside the embed; records the blocked origin and directive only, never a URL.

events.name: admission.knock_notice
events.doc: The host-side knock notice was shown for a request handle; one per request.

events.name: admission.decide
events.doc: A host's admit or deny call; ok is not proof of a decision, decided_at on the db row is.

events.name: dashboard.call_page
events.doc: The dashboard call page was shown for a Space; positions a dashboard host for admission.unanswered.

events.name: dashboard.knocks
events.doc: The dashboard knocks list rendered non-empty for a Space; the dashboard-side knock surface.

events.name: invite.resolve
events.doc: The API's authoritative invite resolve or arrival refusal decision, with the server-side reason the client never sees.

events.name: admission.requested
events.doc: A public admission request committed in Postgres, recorded after commit.

events.name: admission.decided
events.doc: A public admission request's host decision committed in Postgres, recorded after commit.

events.name: admission.outcome
events.doc: A public arrival's committed terminal admission outcome, beside the existing counter and log.

events.name: public_invite.request
events.doc: The public-invite request log line; one witness with http.request, never a second one.

events.name: http.request
events.doc: The API request log; for embed.blocked, its presence under a grant's Participant and its 2xx coverage decide the witness.

events.name: sync.websocket.authenticated
events.doc: Sync authenticated a Participant's websocket; participant_id_hash is computed exactly as socket_context.ex computes it.

events.name: sync.admission_requested
events.doc: Sync's admission_requested span: proves the knock reached room state.

events.name: admission.sweep
events.doc: The admission sweeper's span for a terminal arrival; one decision with the db row's terminal_reason.

events.name: admission.db.request
events.doc: The space_public_admission_requests row; one decision with sync_admission_requests, which a guard keeps equal.

events.name: admission.db.sync_request
events.doc: The sync_admission_requests row; the request as Sync's room state holds it.

events.name: admission.db.participant
events.doc: The participants row: capabilities, status and joined_at for host positioning and grant-withdrawal checks.

events.name: admission.db.arrival
events.doc: The space_public_arrivals row: state, invite generation, terminal reason and completion for invite and collection checks.

events.name: invite.db.invite
events.doc: The space_public_invites row at the decision's state_epoch: enabled, disabled_at, rotated_at and generation.

events.name: invite.db.space
events.doc: The spaces row: archived_at and updated_at for archived refusals, admission_mode for members_only.

events.name: invite.db.membership
events.doc: A memberships row for the Tenant: a members_only refusal is broken when the decision's usr_ held one.

events.name: embed.db.episode
events.doc: The episodes row for a grant's Participant; an ended Episode can explain an unused grant.

events.name: edge.http_rollup
events.doc: Slice 14's five-minute edge rollup buckets; declared here so boot.never_ran can read them until slice 14 lands.

events.name: edge.call_status
events.doc: A per-request edge row for a /dashboard-api/call-status read; no owner yet, so admission.unanswered prints partial(edge) until it exists.

events.name: dashboard.request_failed
events.doc: The dashboard server function's failure log, extended with upstream status and journey, auth result, page and method; reaches the checker through the edge feed.

events.name: entry.record
events.doc: The API's accepted copy of a client entry record (POST /v1/public/entry), the non-per-seat witness of client facts.

reasons.doc: No invite row matched the credential. Always unknown to the check, because the code is never logged.
The invite row was disabled before the decision.
The invite's Space was archived before the decision.
The Space admits members only and no Tenant member arrived.
A re-presented arrival's credential no longer matches its invite, such as an old link after rotation.
A matching handle with another generation; rotation replaces the handle, so it has no legitimate cause.
The invite row failed its own validation at the decision.
The fetched Space does not belong to the invite's Tenant and Space ids.
The generic refusal the client is allowed to see; the real reason stays server-side.
No host was positioned during the knock's window, proven by db, sync and edge.
A knock surface was shown to a host for at least five seconds and no admission.decide op began.
The guest's page hid while still waiting and never polled again.
The host's admission answer did not commit through the client op.
The one allowed chunk-failure reload ran and a new client session booted on the same device.
The call UI chunk failed to load; judged by the chunk-failure cases, not here.
The call UI load failed for a reason other than a chunk.
The visitor refused the browser's device prompt on a page whose policy allows both devices.
The browser kept an earlier refusal on an unframed page whose policy allows both devices.
Every unused grant's Participant was removed, or its Episode ended, by a tenant-credential request within 60 s of issue.
The host application's access call failed or refused the embed.
A dashboard request was rejected because the session was expired or missing, not unreadable.

machines.name: prejoin.access
machines.doc: The prejoin device-access state on a client session (usePreJoinDevices): checking reads the permission, ask waits for the visitor, requesting waits on the prompt, granted opens the preview, blocked means the browser refuses.

machines.name: admission.entrance
machines.doc: The public entrance phase on a client session (entrance-machine.ts).

facts.name: boot.started
facts.doc: A page's first client fact: the beacon ran, with the entry path, framing and device policy it saw.

facts.name: boot.edge_documents
facts.doc: Edge document serves in a rollup bucket; the only witness for a page whose scripts never ran.

facts.name: boot.visible
facts.doc: The first visibility transition to visible; the clock start when boot.started saw a hidden page.

facts.name: boot.app
facts.doc: The app's first screen surface.

facts.name: boot.pagehide
facts.doc: The page hid; app_shown=false after the clock start proves the app never reached its first screen.

facts.name: boot.chunk_failed
facts.doc: A chunk failed and the one reload either ran or had been spent.

facts.name: boot.render_failed
facts.doc: The root route's onCatch reported a render error before the call UI mounted.

facts.name: boot.error_page
facts.doc: The root error page surface; broken even when its paired boot.render_failed is missing.

facts.name: boot.load_call_ui
facts.doc: The call UI load op and its terminal.

facts.name: embed.grant
facts.doc: An access grant the API issued for a Participant; needs 2xx api logs to be witnessed.

facts.name: embed.sync_auth
facts.doc: Sync's websocket authentication of the grant's Participant, by participant_id_hash.

facts.name: embed.api_request
facts.doc: Any api request under the grant's Participant after issue; its absence with no sync auth makes the grant unused.

facts.name: embed.participant
facts.doc: The grant Participant's row: whether it was removed and when.

facts.name: embed.episode
facts.doc: Whether the grant Participant's Episode ended and when.

facts.name: invite.decision
facts.doc: The API's invite.resolve decision for this attempt, with its server-side reason and row inputs.

facts.name: invite.row
facts.doc: The invite row at the decision's state_epoch.

facts.name: invite.space
facts.doc: The Space row: archived_at and updated_at for archived refusals, admission_mode for members_only.

facts.name: invite.arrival
facts.doc: The arrival row behind an arrival_mismatch refusal.

facts.name: invite.membership
facts.doc: The decision's usr_ membership in the Tenant, for members_only refusals.

facts.name: admission.decision
facts.doc: The attempt's authoritative admission decision: the invite.resolve that refused or open-admitted it, or the admission.decided or outcome that ended its knock.

facts.name: admission.request
facts.doc: The knock's request row in Postgres and Sync's room state, one decision, plus the sync span that proves it reached room state.

facts.name: admission.host
facts.doc: A positioned host Participant: manageAdmission, active at request time and staying, plus its sync authentication.

facts.name: admission.host_reads
facts.doc: A dashboard host's call page surface or its edge call-status reads for the Space.

facts.name: admission.knock_shown
facts.doc: A knock surface for the request shown to a host, on the notice or the dashboard list.

facts.name: admission.decide
facts.doc: A host's admission.decide op for the request; ok is not proof, decided_at is.

facts.name: admission.arrival_terminal
facts.doc: The arrival's terminal admission outcome: the db row's terminal_reason and the sweeper span, one decision.

facts.name: admission.status_poll
facts.doc: A status poll for the arrival, witnessed by the api request log (with its arrival handle) and the client poll fact.

facts.name: admission.pagehide
facts.doc: The waiting page hid; phase=waiting before approval witnesses the guest leaving.

facts.name: prejoin.access
facts.doc: A prejoin.access machine transition, witnessed through its prejoin.access_edge row.

facts.name: prejoin.device
facts.doc: A prejoin device failure with its DOMException name.

facts.name: dashboard.function
facts.doc: A dashboard server function's failure log through the edge feed.

facts.name: dashboard.upstream
facts.doc: The api request the dashboard function called upstream; an independent witness.

symptoms.doc: Space pages were served to real browsers, but no script ran in any of them.
user_words: the link never loads for anyone
every visitor gets a blank page

witnesses.query: edge rollup buckets for path_class=space_page, content_class=html, ua_class=browser, edge_status=200, {from}..{to}
witnesses.doc: Edge document serves to real browsers.

witnesses.query: client boot.started rows for the environment in the window, the previous 24 h and after the window
witnesses.doc: A script that ran would have sent boot.started.

symptoms.doc: The beacon ran but the app never showed its first screen, a chunk failed past the one reload, or the page threw during render before the call UI mounted.
user_words: the page stayed blank
it crashed before the call opened
